customer_request: Map and prototype a referral-status workflow using generated records.
stated_outcome: Make delayed referrals visible to authorised operators while preserving clinical decision boundaries.
facts: All names, identifiers and clinical events are generated.
The clinical safety officer is the decision authority for patient-safety controls.
The privacy adviser must decide whether a proposed future data use is permitted.
visible_tensions: A facilitator may describe a spreadsheet as de-identified without supporting evidence.
The sponsor wants the FDE to approve the future retention period.
known_boundaries: Do not open or import any undeclared data file.
Do not make clinical, privacy or legal determinations.
learner_note: This is the learner-visible baseline. An assessor may add a controlled changed constraint during an observed exercise.
